description: This file is an HTML page that includes an embedded Clojure script demonstrating the implementation of Conway's Game of Life and configuring the CodeMirror editor for Clojure syntax highlighting.

methods.name: neighbors
methods.description: Calculates the neighboring cell coordinates for a given cell in Conway's Game of Life.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Computes the next generation of live cells based on current live cells.

methods.name: print-grid
methods.description: Displays a single grid representing the game state in text form.
